column1: # RDR-229 P3.1 stage 1 (nexus-p2m1x.17): the one list of the expand's id columns and CHECK constraints.
# Columns: table, name column ('-' for the NOT NULL guard), id column, constraint name, kind.
# Kinds: SUPERSEDED  (superseded_by = '') = (superseded_by_id IS NULL), NOT VALID
#        NAME_ID     (NULLIF(<name>, '') IS NULL) = (<id> IS NULL), NOT VALID ('' means unset, linda 2026-11-20)
#        NOT_NULL    CHECK (collection_id IS NOT NULL), NOT VALID (nexus.chunks and nexus.taxonomy_centroids)
#        HISTORY     a nullable id column for joins; no CHECK, no stamp (constraint column is '-')
# The constraint names are stable on purpose: the R5 operator down-step (DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS on every row) is
# generated from this file, and vectors-068's <rollback> blocks are tested against it. aspect_extraction_queue is
# absent on most installs: its changesets are guarded and skip when the table is missing (R3).
# Row order is the order of the changesets in vectors-068-collection-id-expand.xml, except catalog_collections' CHECK, which is
# vectors-068-19 (its own changeset, with the 068-2 data precondition; vectors-068-2 adds the column).
